reasoning_content: The Android folder exists but doesn't have gradlew. We need to run `cap sync android` to generate the proper Android project with Gradle.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# Sync capacitor to generate gradle files
c.exec_command("""export JAVA_HOME=/usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64
export ANDROID_HOME=~/android-sdk
cd /opt/areloria/client
which npm || echo 'Check node'""")

# Check for node
c.exec_command("which node && node --version")

c.close()
EOF
